title: Optimize the Harness, Not the Model: Fitting a Minimal Agent to a Self-Hostable LLM for Investigative Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2611.03434v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Government intelligence teams need LLM agents that can analyze large, messy evidence collections, but security and cost constraints often rule out hosted frontier models and broad, hard-to-audit tool surfaces. We report CLEO: Constrained Loop for Environment Optimization, a method for fitting a minimal agent harness to a fixed, self-hostable LLM. Given an expert-validated dataset, CLEO admits only the tools, guardrails, memory policies, and loop components that improve accuracy while remaining general and auditable. On our held-out dataset, the CLEO harness reaches an 83.8% pass rate, within 1.2 points of the strongest out-of-the-box Claude Code SDK baseline, while being two orders of magnitude smaller.

translated_title: 优化智能体框架而非模型：将最小智能体适配到可自托管的大语言模型以进行调查分析
translated_abstract: 政府情报团队需要能够分析大量杂乱证据集合的大语言模型智能体，但安全和成本方面的约束往往排除了托管的前沿模型以及广泛的、难以审计的工具面。我们提出CLEO（环境优化的约束循环），这是一种将最小智能体框架适配到固定的、可自托管的大语言模型的方法。在给定专家验证的数据集的情况下，CLEO只保留那些能够提高准确性、同时保持通用性和可审计性的工具、防护机制、内存策略和循环组件。在我们的保留测试集上，CLEO框架达到了83.8%的通过率，与最强的开箱即用Claude Code SDK基线相差仅1.2个百分点，而其规模要小两个数量级。
tldr: 提出CLEO方法，通过优化最小智能体框架而非模型本身，使其适配可自托管的大语言模型，在调查分析任务上以小两个数量级的规模达到接近最强商用基线的83.8%通过率。
en_tdlr: CLEO optimizes a minimal agent harness—rather than the model itself—to fit a fixed, self-hostable LLM, achieving an 83.8% pass rate on investigative analysis within 1.2 points of the strongest Claude Code SDK baseline while being two orders of magnitude smaller.
